scope: A direct public SessionFile API check on the final retained Linux library. This is a synthetic host filesystem control, not Kindle firmware, installed account storage, an application launch, or a timing measurement.
binary_binding: The independent build owner confirmed the exact retained-source Kindle-feature Linux rlib. Only the standalone probe was compiled with rustc --extern; neither the product nor its dependencies were rebuilt for this control.
limits: This real FUSE experiment stops at the directory guard, not the later file guard. The separate unit test injects a successful protection call that leaves a public file and checks that its held descriptor is still zero bytes. No claim of optical performance, exact Kindle FUSE implementation, accepted persistent login on a shared mount, or package integrity is made.
